authority.creature_identity: existing creature authority; ICF-07..09 only reference authored creature evidence

coverage_rule: All 24 retained MHTs receive an RSR-03 ICF relevance decision. This supplements, but does not rewrite, the completed RSR-01 route registry.

sources.notes: Visible content is Kola-Ha Formcraft/Warforms despite the filename. Forms are bioengineered installed capabilities, not automatically ingredients or harvest outputs. Owner explicitly requested Warforms cost more and be more straining; numerical/effect details in assistant text remain proposal-only.
Recovered content centers on Black Vegas world/campaign systems; no source-supported ICF identity or recipe is required by this pass.
Recovered content is primarily lore/visual/species context; no source-supported ICF content identity is established.
Assistant-authored background material includes a natural-poison harvesting capability. Preserve as a setting-scoped proposal hook; do not invent poison ingredients, yields, effects, or recipes.
Assistant-generated Goblin setting text references medicine/alchemy and crafting organizations/skills. This is institutional/cultural context, not a canonical ingredient/formula corpus.
No material ICF content requiring reconciliation was identified in the retained visible turns.

Assistant-authored material contains Blood Tree harvesting, sap/resin/Bloodcrystal outputs and alchemical-use/yield mechanics. Blood Tree already appears in pre-existing source-recovery/ICF evidence, but these specific outputs, DCs, yields and effects are not promoted; they remain source-bound candidates.

Assistant-authored Early Life Profession material contains crafting perks and an Artisan role. Profession progression belongs DPL/character progression; ICF may supply ingredient/recipe inputs but does not own those bonuses.

Recovered Formcraft material is bioengineering content but does not establish Forms as edible/alchemical/harvest ingredients. Preserve existing Kola-Ha species identity and route biotech mechanics to DPL/CCP/RSR-07 rather than creating ICF ingredient records by inference.

Assistant-generated Vertigon-area text includes vertical agriculture, food distribution and bioengineering enclaves. Treat as world/economy/production context; no ingredient or facility output identity is created here.

Owner establishes Vertigon as extremely prosperous/subsidized; assistant expansion describes food abundance. This constrains economy/worldbuilding but does not define ingredient supply, yield or price. Route to RSR-04/WCI.
Recovered visible material does not establish ICF content requiring a new ingredient/crafting disposition.
Recovered Carnival material is world/campaign structure; no source-supported ICF content identity is established.
Assistant-generated faction perks include weapons/equipment/trans-portal support. Those are loot/equipment/strategic content, not ICF ingredient or recipe authority.
Recovered material is setting/history; no ICF content identity or formula is established.

Assistant-generated species/profession material references harvesting natural resources and crafting survival gear. ICF may own typed harvest inputs, while species bonuses/crafting progression belong CCP/DPL and equipment outcomes flow through existing crafting/LSS seams.
A food-supply change appears only as a hypothetical timeline-crisis example, not as authored food/ingredient content. No ICF record is justified.

Assistant prose references harvested genetic material in species-creation history. Genetic material/biotech research is not automatically an ICF ingredient or harvest output; route to DPL/CCP and retain setting provenance.

Assistant-generated map-region expansions include alchemical agriculture, reagent production, harvesting and distillation contexts. Preserve as world-scoped production proposals; no ingredient effects, yields or values become canonical.

Assistant response to the owner’s Avian-species request assigns agriculture/food/brewing roles to one species. Treat as proposed cultural/economic role; do not infer livestock outputs, ingredients or production stats.

Assistant-generated city-network text describes cuisine depending on ingredients from several worlds. Preserve as cross-reality cuisine/sourcing context only; no named ingredients or recipes are invented.

Owner explicitly requires multiple mana types with sources/value/effects/rarity, but mana is a supernatural resource model, not automatically an ICF ingredient. Assistant-generated mana types/properties remain proposals and route to RSR-07/MSS.
Cooking and material production appear only as generic examples inside an assistant-generated post-scarcity social-design exploration. No ingredient, recipe or production identity is created.

Owner establishes overt gamified realities; assistant proposes crafting interfaces, recipes/material requirements, cooking progression and resource rules. ICF can supply recipe/material semantics, but interface/progression/Reality-Kernel authority belongs later WCI/SGC/DPL work.
